app_tagline: Offline, private scam checker for India
input_placeholder: Paste SMS, WhatsApp message, or notice here...
next_steps: What you should do in next 5 minutes:
emergency_bank: Immediately Call Your Bank & Freeze Cards

reasons.electricity_threat: Threatens electricity power cut at night to create panic.
reasons.fake_kyc: Urges immediate KYC or PAN update through unauthorized channels.
reasons.upi_collect_fraud: Requests entering UPI PIN to receive money (You never need a PIN to receive).
reasons.digital_arrest: Claims police/CBI/customs arrest over video call (Digital Arrest is 100% fake).
reasons.courier_customs: Demands fees for a detained parcel or customs clearance.
reasons.job_task: Offers unrealistic daily income for liking videos or rating maps.
reasons.lottery_prize: Claims prize money or lottery win requiring upfront clearance fees.
reasons.loan_app_risk: Promotes unauthorized instant loan apps through direct APK downloads.
reasons.investment_fraud: Promises guaranteed high returns via private WhatsApp/Telegram channels.
reasons.suspicious_link: Contains a suspicious URL, shortener, or dangerous file extension.
reasons.genuine_warning: Contains official bank safety markers ('Do not share OTP').
reasons.link_shortener: Uses a link shortener (e.g., bit.ly) to hide destination website.
reasons.link_ip_address: Direct IP link used instead of a registered domain.
reasons.link_risky_tld: Uses a high-risk domain extension (.xyz, .top, etc.).
reasons.link_apk_download: Directly downloads an APK file to your phone.
reasons.link_brand_impersonation: Impersonates a bank or government service.
reasons.upi_impersonation_handle: UPI ID contains suspicious fraud words ('refund', 'support').
reasons.upi_pin_warning: Warning: You never enter your PIN to receive money.
reasons.phone_personal_claiming_official: Personal 10-digit mobile number claiming to be an official bank.
reasons.phone_foreign_origin: Foreign phone number originating outside India.
